remarks: Welcome Home! Bright and Airy! Gorgeous 3 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath home with Cathedral Ceilings and Large entertainment spaces! Beautiful hardwood floors throughout the home! X-tra Large windows! Updated Kitchen, Bathrooms and some newer appliances! Natural Gas Heating, City Water and City Sewer! Terrific Cul-De-Sac Location!! Tucked away amongst nature, this home is just minutes to shopping, restaurants, schools, 5 min from Train Station & public parks! Truly an Open Floor plan with a beautiful fireplace!!! Sliders from Kitchen to the Large expansive Deck completes the home. Ample room in the Finished Basement for a home office / storage / gym plus 2 Car Garage! A very easy to maintain property that has been well kept over the years. **Highest and BEST by 1pm on Monday 6/2/25**
